title: Twin serif phrases around a splitting wordmark
summary: Two 2-line serif phrases rise out of clip masks above and below a small centred wordmark; the mark splits in half and pushes the phrases apart, then the top phrase drops away and the bottom one holds alone.
use_when: A fashion, beauty or lifestyle brand opening a campaign with a two-part contrast line
Silent autoplay feeds where type alone carries a short editorial statement
A 6 s intro or bumper in 4:5 before product shots
Brands with a short all-caps wordmark that reads when split into two halves

look.type_style: high-contrast condensed italic serif display, sentence case, tight leading (~0.9), each line ~11 % H; small bold grotesk caps wordmark ~2 % H; tiny mono caps corner labels ~1 % H

sfx.event: each phrase line lands out of its mask
top phrase drops out of its mask

structure.shot: white page, small wordmark centred, four tiny corner labels; a 2-word phrase on 2 lines rises above it, a second 2-word phrase below
structure.motion: per line rise out of a clip mask, line starts f1 / f5 / f10 / f14 (stagger 4-5 fr), each line easings.outExpo 8 fr, all settled f24; overshoot not visible on the 30 fps strip

structure.shot: the wordmark splits into its two halves which slide to the phrase edges; the two phrases push apart to open a wide middle band; hold
structure.motion: split starts f39, halves travel to the left and right text edges, top phrase up ~8 % H, bottom phrase down ~8 % H, one curve easings.inOutSine 15 fr (f39-f54); hold f54-f105

structure.shot: top phrase and both wordmark halves leave, a near-invisible ghost of them stays; bottom phrase holds in place
structure.motion: top phrase drops into its clip masks, lower line first f105-f108, upper line f109-f112 (stagger 4 fr), easings.inExpo 4 fr; wordmark halves fade 3 fr at f106; ghost left at ~3 % opacity

structure.shot: bottom phrase alone on white, corner labels faded to the same faint ghost
structure.motion: corner labels fade between 4.27 and 4.50 s (±0.25 s, easing not measurable); then a full hold of 45 fr to the end

params.brand: any brand.json: display font (an italic serif works best), fg, bg, mono for the corner labels
params.content.mark: short all-caps wordmark text, split at its midpoint (4-6 letters)
params.content.top: first phrase, 2 words, one per line (the 'before' half of the contrast)
params.content.bottom: second phrase, 2 words, one per line (the half that stays to the end)
params.content.labels: four tiny corner labels: top-left, top-centre, top-right, bottom-centre ('' = none)
params.aspect: 4:5 native; 9:16 and 1:1 keep the vertical stack
params.timing.stagger: frames between line entrances (default 4.5 at 30 fps)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: One continuous shot, zero cuts; rows split at state changes measured on 30 fps strips (1 fr) except the corner-label fade (sheet cells, ±0.25 s). transition_out hard-cut is the schema default only, no cut happens. Entrances are per line, not per letter. Exits are 4 fr, half the 8 fr entrance. Ghost of the removed phrase stays at ~3 % opacity to the end. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): mark-split, ghost-hold. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Palette sampled from keyframes 0.5/2.5/4.5 s since there are no cut frames. motion.json zoom 1.3 %/s in 4-6 s is not visible on the sheets (bottom phrase width unchanged), so no push-in. Catalogue hints typewriter / card-grid / hard-cut were not seen.
